source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: expressions and the BMI activity (PDF 40).

blocks.text: Expression variables, operators aur values ka aisa combination (mel) hai jo result (nateeja) deta hai. Maslan 3 + 4 ek expression hai jis ka nateeja 7 hai. Lambi expressions mein parentheses (brackets) ( ) laga kar tay kiya jata hai ke kaunsa hisaab pehle ho. Misaal:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab "parentheses O" chhapti hai; yahan parentheses ( ) hain, jaise oopar ki misaal mein.
Yahan pehle brackets ke andar 3 + 4 = 7 hota hai, phir 7 * 2 = 14.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Body Mass Index (BMI) nikalne ka program likhein. User se us ka weight (wazan) aur height (qad) poochhein, phir BMI aur us ki classification (kis group mein aata hai, jaise normal ya overweight) dikhayein. BMI is formula se nikalta hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab formula BMI = weight / height chhapti hai. BMI mein weight ko height ke square (height x height) se divide kiya jata hai: BMI = weight / height². Python mein: bmi = weight / height ** 2.

blocks.prompt: BMI program se 72 kg aur 1.8 m wale insaan ka BMI kya hai?
blocks.explanation: 72 / 1.8 ** 2 = 72 / 3.24 = 22.2. Classification ki limits (maslan 18.5 se 24.9 normal) aam sehat ki guidance (rehnumai) hain, kitab mein nahi di gayin.

items: Expression result deta hai; ( ) wala hissa pehle hal hota hai: (3 + 4) * 2 = 14.
